title: Dancervibes
summary: A dance event and class management platform with role-based operations, live availability, QR tickets and mobile entry validation.
challenge: Organisers needed one system to manage events and classes while customers needed reliable live availability and ticketing at the point of entry.
solution: Designed four roles: Super Admin, Organiser, Customer and Ticket Checker.
Built event and class management with capacity limits.
Implemented live slot availability and customer booking.
Generated QR-coded tickets for confirmed bookings.
Built a mobile-optimised ticket scanner for real-time validation.
Added central administration for users, events, revenue and configuration.
outcomes: End-to-end booking and entry flow supporting multiple concurrent events.
